BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fish protection costs; and adding a new sectionto chapter 80.28 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 80.28 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Every electric company that sends bills to retail customers mustprovide a notice in the bill, in easily understandable language,concerning the percentage of the retail electric customer's bill thatis directly attributable to the costs for fish protection.
